what: the multiple precision flow of tools/refine-mp.py with the settings of the preset w1 of tools/witness.py (40 digits, tolerance 1e-26, step floor 1e-14) against the exact Kepler flow of tools/kepler-ref.py: one nominal period of a near-radial pair with periapsis distance q, apocentre start with a = 1, e = 1 - q, third body of mass 1 at rest at (1e9, 0); error = |difference| / max(1, |exact|) over the four relative numbers of the pair; a row passes if the flow finishes (status done, no collapse of the step size) and the error is at most the limit. The rows q = 1e-6 and 1e-7 are the conditions for the range of w1 (minimum pair distance 1e-7 or more); the row q = 3e-8 is information only. The command of every row is in the field command (OUT.json is a new file).
